budgetPolicy.formula: max(minimumSeconds, ceil(calculationFrames / rowsPerSecondFloor) + marginSeconds), capped at maximumSeconds
budgetPolicy.note: --budget-seconds is the floor, not the value: the 12 fixtures above 135k calculation frames need 2,195-2,439 s at the measured 61.5-100 rows/s (EXP-P0-075 §6), so a fixed 1800 s budget truncated them by construction

totalRowsPerSide.definition: captured = rows summed over the fixtures that produced a row count; expected = the manifest calculationFrames of those same fixtures; allManifest = every fixture in replay-fixtures.json

retryPolicy.rule: a fixture whose last entry is ok/mismatch is skipped; a failed or timeout entry is retried until it has maxAttemptsPerFixture entries, then left exhausted for a human

journalFieldNotes.actual_sha256: the captured trace's official canonical hash (compare-replay-traces.trace_sha256)
journalFieldNotes.rows_file_sha256: SHA-256 of rows.jsonl bytes -- not the canonical hash
journalFieldNotes.replay_sha256: SHA-256 of the .rpy replay file (manifest field sha256)
journalFieldNotes.budgetSeconds: EXP-P0-076: the per-fixture --budget-seconds this entry ran with (adaptive, >= --budget-seconds, capped at 5400)
journalFieldNotes.timed_out: true when the run was cut off (wall clock or observer watchdog); such an entry is status=timeout and is never a success
journalFieldNotes.startStage: EXP-P0-076: the observer --start-stage (the manifest's first stage index; Extra fixtures use 8)
